title: Ciranda, cirandinha
attribution: Anonymous Brazilian circle-game song of Portuguese origin; the verses are old folk quatrains found in 19th-century collections and the tune was already in print when Heitor Villa-Lobos quoted it in "O Polichinelo" (1918), so melody and words are public domain. Melody checked against the score and MIDI at Mama Lisa's World (transposed from B flat to G); each half is sung twice, as in that score.
